In detail

West Midlands Police recorded 940 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 12.8 per 1,000 residents, the 20th highest rate of Birmingham's 69 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (35), vehicle crime (24), burglary (9); the evening/night score by violent crime (136), public order (26), anti social behaviour (9). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Glebe Farm & Tile Cross safe?

Wandroz currently rates Glebe Farm & Tile Cross in Birmingham as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham at night. This rating is derived from West Midlands Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Glebe Farm & Tile Cross safe at night?

At night, Glebe Farm & Tile Cross is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Glebe Farm & Tile Cross a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Glebe Farm & Tile Cross's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Birmingham) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
